title: Constant Packed Arrays (at least in a dictionary) cause a crash when accessed
body:
### Tested versions

- reproducible in Godot v4.8.dev (cd9c5d57f)

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (cd9c5d57f) - roachOS #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon, 21 Sep 2026 18:51:14 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors (1920x1080 @ 143.98 Hz, 1920x1200 @ 59.95 Hz) - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti (nvidia; 615.71.09) - AMD Ryzen 5 2600 Six-Core Processor (12 threads) - 46.96 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When you try to access a constant `PackedStringArray` (at least from a Dictionary), the engine segfaults and gives the gdscript backtrace on line at which access happend

### Steps to reproduce

just make a `Dictionary` with any key but values of it must be `PackedStringArray`s

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

dont need a project i think because its a script issue, sorry if im wrong.

stripped down version of my code (for testing only)

```gdscript
extends Node2D

@export var hint_label: Label

enum DeathCause {
	GENERIC,
	EXPLODED,
	BURNED,
	DROWNED
}

const TIPS: Dictionary[DeathCause, PackedStringArray] = {
	DeathCause.GENERIC: [
		"Message 0",
		"Message 1",
		"Message 2",
	],
	DeathCause.EXPLODED: [
		"Message 0",
		"Message 1",
		"Message 2",
	],
	DeathCause.BURNED: [
		"Message 0",
		"Message 1",
		"Message 2",
	],
	DeathCause.DROWNED: [
		"Message 0",
		"Message 1",
		"Message 2",
	]
}

func _ready() -> void:
	var cause: DeathCause = DeathCause.GENERIC
	hint_label.text = "Tip: %s" % TIPS[cause][randi_range(0, TIPS[cause].size() - 1)]

```
